title: FlipCTL Plugin IPC Messages
description: NDJSON-over-stdio protocol between flipctld and a plugin process. Each line of stdin/stdout is exactly one JSON object matching one of the shapes below. See backend.md §5. The same plugin-to-core shapes (output/log/done/error) are also what is re-broadcast, unwrapped, as SSE `data:` payloads on GET /api/jobs/{jobId}/events (openapi.yaml, backend.md §7).

coreToPlugin.description: Written to the plugin's stdin. `start` is sent once at spawn. For execution=stream|daemon, stdin stays open for the process lifetime and further `event` messages may arrive at any time (backend.md §4.4, §5).

inputs.description: Map of input id -> resolved value, keyed per the plugin's manifest inputs[].

name.description: Matches an action's on_press/on_release effect.name in the manifest.

oneOf.description: Optional graceful-stop hint (backend.md §5). The core does not wait indefinitely for a response: SIGTERM (then SIGKILL after a timeout) is sent regardless, so this is purely an opportunity for cleanup, not a required handshake.

pluginToCore.description: Written to the plugin's stdout, one JSON object per line.

oneOf.description: Signals a successful spawn; Job transitions Pending -> Running (backend.md §6).

fields.description: Map of output id -> value. Keys must match the plugin's manifest outputs[].id; value type must match the declared output type (text: string, number: number, list: array of strings).

line.description: Raw text for history/debugging. Not required to map onto any declared output.

oneOf.description: Terminal message for one-shot/stream jobs. Job transitions Running -> Completed (exit_code=0) or Failed (exit_code!=0).
Terminal message. Job transitions Running -> Failed.
